title: Present Perfect (For vs Since)
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora puedes hablar con precisión sobre la duración de tu experiencia y de eventos.

stages.title: Present Perfect con For y Since

parts.visual:
Usamos FOR para indicar un periodo de tiempo (cuánto tiempo ha durado). 
Ej: I have worked here FOR five years (por cinco años). 
She has been a manager FOR three months (por tres meses).
parts.audio: We use FOR to indicate a period of time, or how long something has lasted. For example: I have worked here for five years. She has been a manager for three months.

parts.visual:
Usamos SINCE para indicar un punto exacto en el tiempo (cuándo empezó). 
Ej: I have worked here SINCE 2018 (desde 2018). 
She has been a manager SINCE January (desde enero).
parts.audio: We use SINCE to indicate an exact point in time when something started. For example: I have worked here since 2018. She has been a manager since January.

questions.question: I have been with this company ____ ten years. (Por 10 años - periodo).
questions.explanation: 'Ten years' es una duración/periodo de tiempo, usamos 'for'.

questions.question: We have known each other ____ 2015. (Desde 2015 - punto de inicio).
questions.explanation: '2015' es un año exacto en el que inició la acción, usamos 'since'.

questions.question: The CEO has been in a meeting ____ 9:00 AM. (Desde las 9 - punto de inicio).
She hasn't taken a vacation ____ three years. (Por 3 años - periodo).
They have lived in London ____ last March. (Desde el marzo pasado).
I have been waiting for the email ____ two hours! (Por 2 horas).
We have used this software ____ a long time. (Por mucho tiempo).
questions.explanation: 'A long time' es un periodo = for (for a long time).

questions.question: He has been the marketing director ____ he joined the company. (Desde que se unió).
questions.explanation: Un evento en el pasado (él se unió a la empresa) marca el inicio = since.

questions.question: Our profits have increased ____ the beginning of the year. (Desde el principio).
questions.explanation: 'The beginning of the year' es un punto en el tiempo = since.

questions.question: The factory has been closed ____ several months. (Por varios meses).
I haven't seen the manager ____ Monday. (Desde el lunes).
We have been partners ____ six months. (Por 6 meses).
She has worked remotely ____ the pandemic started. (Desde que empezó).
questions.explanation: Evento de inicio (the pandemic started) = since.

questions.question: I have had this laptop ____ a week, and it's already broken. (Por una semana).
They haven't updated their website ____ 2019. (Desde 2019).
We have had the same boss ____ five years. (Por cinco años).
I haven't spoken to him ____ we had that argument. (Desde que tuvimos esa discusión).
questions.explanation: Evento pasado que marca el inicio = since.

questions.question: He hasn't taken a day off ____ Christmas. (Desde Navidad).
We have been negotiating this contract ____ weeks. (Por semanas).
I have known the CEO ____ I was a child. (Desde que era niño).
I have worked here ____ five years. (Por)
I have worked here ____ 2018. (Desde)
She hasn't called ____ Monday. (Desde)
We have been waiting ____ two hours. (Por)
He has been sick ____ a week. (Por)
They haven't updated it ____ January. (Desde)
We have known each other ____ a long time. (Por)
I haven't seen her ____ the meeting started. (Desde)
We have had this office ____ ten months. (Por)
He has lived there ____ he was a kid. (Desde)
